verdict.rationale: Relay claims to capture receipts, categorize expenses in real time, and sync automatically to accounting software (relay-docs-3), which directly addresses the story, but there is no detail on which accounting platforms are supported, how the sync works, or any independent/hands-on confirmation that this sync functions reliably. Missing for 10: named accounting-software integrations (e.g., QuickBooks/Xero), setup/configuration documentation, and independent verification of sync accuracy or reliability.
